watermarks.title: Disk watermarks
watermarks.description: Disk usage thresholds for allocation and the flood stage.
watermarks.keywords: disk free used flood threshold headroom
watermarks.low_hint: No new shards are allocated to nodes above this.
watermarks.high_hint: Shards are moved away from nodes above this.
watermarks.flood_hint: Indices on nodes above this become read-only.
watermarks.mode_percent: Percentages and ratios describe used disk space.
watermarks.mode_bytes: Byte values describe required free disk space.
watermarks.threshold_disabled_warning: Without disk thresholds, Elasticsearch no longer protects nodes from running out of disk space.
watermarks.lowering_warning: Raising thresholds lets nodes fill further and should be temporary.
watermarks.restored: Disk watermarks restored to the defaults.

errors.mixed: Use either percentages for all thresholds or byte values for all thresholds.
errors.percent_order: Thresholds must increase from low to high to flood stage.
errors.bytes_order: Free space values must decrease from low to high to flood stage.
